title: البردة
author: الإمام شرف الدين البوصيري
source: النص العربي بالإملاء المعياري، والترجمة الإنجليزية من الطبعة المرفقة

t: My master, bless and salute always and forevermore
Your most beloved, creation’s greatest entirely.

bayts.s: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مُنْشِئِ الْخَلْقِ مِنْ عَدَمِ
bayts.e: ثُمَّ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ فِي الْقِدَمِ
t: Praise God, the bringer of all creation from nullity.
Then blessing be on the Chosen One from eternity.

bayts.e: مَزَجْتَ دَمْعًا جَرَى مِنْ مُقْلَةٍ بِدَمِ
t: Is it from thinking of neighbours past in Dhū Selemi
That you have mixed blood in tears that flow from eyes steadily?

bayts.s: أَمْ هَبَّتِ الرِّيحُ مِنْ تِلْقَاءِ كَاظِمَةٍ
bayts.e: وَأَوْمَضَ الْبَرْقُ فِي الظَّلْمَاءِ مِنْ إِضَمِ
t: Or blowing of wind from the direction of Kāẓimah,
And lightning flashing from Iḍum in the dark that you see?

bayts.s: فَمَا لِعَيْنَيْكَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اكْفُفَا هَمَتَا
bayts.e: وَمَا لِقَلْبِكَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اسْتَفِقْ يَهِمِ
t: So what is wrong with your eyes: when you say “Stop!” they just weep?
And with your heart: when you say, “Be sane!” it acts crazily?
Does one so lovestruck imagine love is concealable,
Between a downpour from it and being so fiery?

bayts.s: لَوْلَا الْهَوَى لَمْ تُرِقْ دَمْعًا عَلَى طَلَلٍ
t: If not for passion, you would have never burst into tears
At the remains, nor lost sleep over the mount or the tree.

bayts.s: فَكَيْفَ تُنْكِرُ حُبًّا بَعْدَ مَا شَهِدَتْ
t: So how do you still deny a love to which testified
Against you true witnesses of tears and infirmity;
When grief has fixed on your cheeks canals of tears and malaise
Like branches of dogwood, red, and daffodils, yellowy?

bayts.s: نَعَمْ سَرَى طَيْفُ مَنْ أَهْوَى فَأَرَّقَنِي
t: Yes, sights of my love have come at night and kept me awake;
How love repels all delights and comforts with agony!

bayts.s: يَا لَائِمِي فِي الْهَوَى الْعُذْرِيِّ مَعْذِرَةً
bayts.e: مِنِّي إِلَيْكَ وَلَوْ أَنْصَفْتَ لَمْ تَلُمِ
t: You critic of love so passionate, an apology
From me to you — but if you were true, you’d not censure me.
May you be spared what I bear — my secret isn’t concealed
From haters, nor is there any end to my malady.

bayts.e: إِنَّ الْمُحِبَّ عَنِ الْعُذَّالِ فِي صَمَمِ
t: You’ve offered me true advice, but simply, I hear it not;
The lover is deaf to all of those who speak critically.

bayts.s: إِنِّي اتَّهَمْتُ نَصِيحَ الشَّيْبِ فِي عَذَلِ
bayts.e: وَالشَّيْبُ أَبْعَدُ فِي نُصْحٍ عَنِ التُّهَمِ
t: I’ve even doubted grey hair’s advice when it censures me;
Although grey hair with advice is less in dubiety.
My evil ego, in its stupidity, paid no heed
To all the warning of greying hair and seniority.

bayts.s: وَلَا أَعَدَّتْ مِنَ الْفِعْلِ الْجَمِيلِ قِرَى
t: And hasn’t set out a spread of pleasing actions to host
A guest who showed at my head, bereft of timidity.

bayts.s: لَوْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي مَا أُوَقِّرُهُ
bayts.e: كَتَمْتُ سِرًّا بَدَا لِي مِنْهُ بِالْكَتَمِ
t: And had I known that I’d fail to honour him, I’d have hid-
Den using hair colorant his first appearance to me.

bayts.s: مَنْ لِي بِرَدِّ جِمَاحٍ مِنْ غَوَايَتِهَا
t: Who’s there for me to control the fight of its wandering —
Just as a bit bridles horses in their obstinacy?
So do not count on offences to get rid of its lust;
Food only intensifies the craving of gluttony.

bayts.s: وَالنَّفْسُ كَالطِّفْلِ إِنْ تُهْمِلْهُ شَبَّ عَلَى
t: The ego is like a baby: leave it and it grows up
In love with suckling; but wean it, and it’s weaned finally.

bayts.e: إِنَّ الْهَوَى مَا تَوَلَّى يُصْمِ أَوْ يَصِمِ
t: So fight its whim, and beware of giving power to it;
When whim’s empowered, it kills or damages markedly.

bayts.e: وَإِنْ هِيَ اسْتَحْلَتِ الْمَرْعَى فَلَا تُسِمِ
t: And shepherd it carefully as it is grazing in deeds;
And if the pasture you find it fancies, don’t let it be.

bayts.e: مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَدْرِ أَنَّ السُّمَّ فِي الدَّسَمِ
t: How many times it’s convinced a man of killer delights —
While blind to the poison in the gravy so savoury!

bayts.s: وَاخْشَ الدَّسَائِسَ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَمِنْ شِبَعٍ
t: Beware the ambush of being hungry and being full;
Starvation at times is even worse than satiety.

bayts.s: وَاسْتَفْرِغِ الدَّمْعَ مِنْ عَيْنٍ قَدِ امْتَلَأَتْ
t: And void of tears eyes that have been stuffed with forbidden things.
Keep in the shelter of pure repentance unceasingly.
And contradict both the Self and Devil, and disobey!
And if they give true advice to you, still look skeptically.

bayts.s: وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمَا خَصْمًا وَلَا حَكَمًا
t: And do not settle with either as your lawyer or foe;
You’re well aware of a lawyer’s and a foe’s treachery.

bayts.s: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ مِنْ قَوْلٍ بِلَا عَمَلِ
bayts.e: لَقَدْ نَسَبْتُ بِهِ نَسْلًا لِذِي عُقُمِ
t: I ask for pardon from God for empty word with no deed;
I have ascribed by it to a sterile man progeny.

bayts.s: أَمَرْتُكَ الْخَيْرَ لَكِنْ مَا ائْتَمَرْتُ بِهِ
bayts.e: وَمَا اسْتَقَمْتُ فَمَا قَوْلِي لَكَ اسْتَقِمِ
t: I’ve ordered you to do good, but have ignored it, myself;
I’m not upstanding, so who am I to tell you to be?

bayts.e: وَلَمْ أُصَلِّ سِوَى فَرْضٍ وَلَمْ أَصُمِ
t: I haven’t packed extra deeds in preparation for death;
I haven’t prayed, haven’t fasted, but the compulsory.

bayts.s: ظَلَمْتُ سُنَّةَ مَنْ أَحْيَا الظَّلَامَ إِلَى
bayts.e: أَنِ اشْتَكَتْ قَدَمَاهُ الضُّرَّ مِنْ وَرَمِ
t: I’ve violated the way of him who livened the dark,
Until his feet had complained of swelling up painfully;
And out of hunger, would bind his abdomen and would wrap
Beneath a hard stone a waist whose skin is so velvety.
The lofty mountains made into gold for him tried to be
A way to bait him, so he true loftiness let them see.

bayts.e: إِنَّ الضَّرُورَةَ لَا تَعْدُو عَلَى الْعِصَمِ
t: His “poverty” only strengthened his disinterest in them;
For never are protectees assaulted by poverty.

bayts.s: وَكَيْفَ تَدْعُو إِلَى الدُّنْيَا ضَرُورَةُ مَنْ
bayts.e: لَوْلَاهُ لَمْ تُخْرَجِ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الْعَدَمِ
t: How could it tempt to this world—the “poverty” of him who
If not for him, the whole world would not have been made to be.
Muḥammad, the master of both worlds and both beings and
Both groups: the Arabs and the non-Arab community;

bayts.e: أَبَرَّ فِي قَوْلِ لَا مِنْهُ وَلَا نَعَمِ
t: Our prophet, who is commander and forbidder — there is
No one more true in his saying no or yes than is he.
He is the loved one whose intercession we’re hopeful of,
At every horror to hit — yes, every calamity.
He has invited to God, so all who grip onto him
Are gripping rope that will never fray for eternity.

bayts.s: فَاقَ النَّبِيِّينَ فِي خَلْقٍ وَفِي خُلُقٍ
bayts.e: وَلَمْ يُدَانُوهُ فِي عِلْمٍ وَلَا كَرَمِ
t: He tops the prophets in both appearance and character;
They don’t approach him in knowledge or in gen’rosity.

bayts.e: غَرْفًا مِنَ الْبَحْرِ أَوْ رَشْفًا مِنَ الدِّيَمِ
t: And all of them are receiving from Allāh’s Messenger
A sip from down-pouring rain or handful scooped from the sea.

bayts.e: مِنْ نُقْطَةِ الْعِلْمِ أَوْ مِنْ شَكْلَةِ الْحِكَمِ
t: And all are standing before him at their own limits fixed:
A dot of knowledge or mark from words of sagacity.
He is the one with perfected essence and outward form;
Picked as the love of the Maker of all humanity.
Beyond a partner in his so beautiful qualities;
Yes, undivided in him is beauty’s whole entity.

bayts.s: دَعْ مَا ادَّعَتْهُ النَّصَارَى فِي نَبِيِّهِمِ
bayts.e: وَاحْكُمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ مَدْحًا فِيهِ وَاحْتَكِمِ
t: Avoid what Christians have claimed about their own messenger;
And give to him any praise you wish, and praise sensibly.

bayts.s: وَانْسُبْ إِلَى ذَاتِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَرَفٍ
bayts.e: وَانْسُبْ إِلَى قَدْرِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ عِظَمِ
t: Ascribe to his person what you wish of nobility;
Ascribe to his stature what you wish of immensity.

bayts.s: فَإِنَّ فَضْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ
t: Indeed, Allah’s Messenger’s perfection has no frontier
That any speaker could ever verbalize orally.

bayts.e: أَحْيَا اسْمُهُ حِينَ يُدْعَى دَارِسَ الرِّمَمِ
t: And were his marvels to match his worth in greatness, his name,
When called, would give life to bones decayed to nihility.

bayts.s: لَمْ يَمْتَحِنَّا بِمَا تَعْيَا الْعُقُولُ بِهِ
bayts.e: حِرْصًا عَلَيْنَا فَلَمْ نَرْتَبْ وَلَمْ نَهِمِ
t: He tried us not, from concern, with things that boggle the mind;
And so we haven’t faced any doubt or perplexity.

bayts.s: أَعْيَا الْوَرَى فَهْمُ مَعْنَاهُ فَلَيْسَ يُرَى
bayts.e: فِي الْقُرْبِ وَالْبُعْدِ فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْفَحِمِ
t: Conceiving his meaning has exhausted the universe;
So near or far, one not dumbstruck by it you will not see.
Much like the sun: from afar it does appear small to eyes,
And would impair any vision when in proximity.
And how could people asleep, distracted from him by dreams,
Begin to grasp in the present world his reality!
The peak of knowledge about him is that he is a man
And is the best of Allah’s creation, entirely.

bayts.s: وَكُلُّ آيٍ أَتَى الرُّسْلُ الْكِرَامُ بِهَا
t: And all the marvels the noble messengers have conveyed
Have come to them from the light of Aḥmad exclusively.
He is the Sun of esteem, to which they are as if moons:
Reflecting its lights in darknesses to humanity.
How grand the form of a Prophet brightened by character,
Enveloped by handsomeness, distinguished by jollity!

bayts.s: كَالزَّهْرِ فِي تَرَفٍ وَالْبَدْرِ فِي شَرَفٍ
bayts.e: وَالْبَحْرِ فِي كَرَمٍ وَالدَّهْرِ فِي هِمَمِ
t: Like flowers in fineness, the full moon in ascendancy,
The ocean in giving, and all time in tenacity.

bayts.e: فِي عَسْكَرٍ حِينَ تَلْقَاهُ وَفِي حَشَمِ
t: When he’s alone and you meet him, he is like one amid
An army and entourage, because of his majesty.
From treasure chests of his eloquence and his beaming grin
Do seem to be pearls preserved within their shells preciously.

bayts.s: لَا طِيبَ يَعْدِلُ تُرْبًا ضَمَّ أَعْظُمَهُ
t: No scent compares to the earth embracing his blessed form;
For him who sniffs it or kisses it, what felicity!
His noble birth did reveal the purity of his roots.
How pure the outset of them as well as finality!
A day the Persians perceived that they indeed had been warned
Of the occurrence of suffering and adversity.
The Arch of Khosrau had passed the night while falling apart;
Just like the status of Khosrau’s peers: without unity.

bayts.e: عَلَيْهِ وَالنَّهْرُ سَاهِي الْعَيْنِ مِنْ سَدَمِ
t: The fire was short of breath out of regret over it.
The river lost all its current out of despondency.
It saddened Sāwa to find the drying up of its lake,
And thirsty seekers returning from the place angrily.

bayts.s: كَأَنَّ بِالنَّارِ مَا بِالْمَاءِ مِنْ بَلَلٍ
bayts.e: حُزْنًا وَبِالْمَاءِ مَا بِالنَّارِ مِنْ ضَرَمِ
t: As if the fire had gotten water’s wetness from grief;
And water had burnt up as a fire burns seethingly.

bayts.e: وَالْحَقُّ يَظْهَرُ مِنْ مَعْنًى وَمِنْ كَلِمِ
t: The jinn were speaking aloud, and lights were shining so bright;
The Truth is made manifest in signal and verbally.
But blind and deaf they were so the happy news went unheard;
And flashes of lightning as a warning they didn’t see.

bayts.s: مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَخْبَرَ الْأَقْوَامَ كَاهِنُهُمْ
t: All after their fortune teller notified all the folk
Their old religion so crooked soon would no longer be.

bayts.s: وَبَعْدَ مَا عَايَنُوا فِي الْأُفْقِ مِنْ شُهُبٍ
bayts.e: مُنْقَضَّةٍ وَفْقَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ صَنَمِ
t: And after they eyed in the horizons the shooting stars
All crashing like statues in the earth for idolatry.

bayts.s: حَتَّى غَدَا عَنْ طَرِيقِ الْوَحْيِ مُنْهَزِمٌ
t: Until from the source of revelation, up in the sky,
One after the other, each retreating demon did flee.

bayts.e: أَوْ عَسْكَرٌ بِالْحَصَى مِنْ رَاحَتَيْهِ رُمِي
t: They were when fleeing just like the heroes of Abrahah,
Or like a pelted-with-pebbles-from-his-hands infantry.
Hurled after having extolled while in the palms of his hands;
Hurled like the swallowed extoller from the gut cavity.

bayts.e: تَمْشِي إِلَيْهِ عَلَى سَاقٍ بِلَا قَدَمِ
t: The trees had come for his call, prostrate in humility;
They came to him on their trunks, like footless legs, walking free.
As if they had drawn along the way a straight line for what
Their branches had written in the finest calligraphy.
Just like the cloud moving with him as he moved anywhere;
From noon’s intense oven heat protecting him constantly.
I swear an oath by the moon, which split in two, that it has
A likeness to his pure heart — an oath of veracity.

bayts.s: وَمَا حَوَى الْغَارُ مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَمِنْ كَرَمِ
bayts.e: وَكُلُّ طَرْفٍ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ عَنْهُ عَمِي
t: And what the cave did contain of good and nobility;
With every look from the disbelievers too blind to see.

bayts.s: فَالصِّدْقُ فِي الْغَارِ وَالصِّدِّيقُ لَمْ يَرِمَا
bayts.e: وَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا بِالْغَارِ مِنْ أَرِمِ
t: The Truth and Truthful in Faith inside the cave hadn’t moved;
All while they were saying that inside the cave none could be.

bayts.e: خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّةِ لَمْ تَنْسُجْ وَلَمْ تَحُمِ
t: They thought no dove hovered and no spider spun any web,
For him, the Best of Creation — thinking its vacancy.

bayts.e: مِنَ الدُّرُوعِ وَعَنْ عَالٍ مِنَ الْأُطُمِ
t: Protection from God made needless reinforced armature,
Or towering citadels providing security.

bayts.s: مَا سَامَنِي الدَّهْرُ ضَيْمًا وَاسْتَجَرْتُ بِهِ
bayts.e: إِلَّا وَنِلْتُ جِوَارًا مِنْهُ لَمْ يُضَمِ
t: No day has time gone to harm me and I have sought his care,
But that I have gotten care from him, without mockery.

bayts.s: وَلَا الْتَمَسْتُ غِنَى الدَّارَيْنِ مِنْ يَدِهِ
bayts.e: إِلَّا اسْتَلَمْتُ النَّدَى مِنْ خَيْرِ مُسْتَلَمِ
t: Nor have I asked of the riches of both worlds from his hand,
Without largesse from the best of givers coming to me.

bayts.s: لَا تُنْكِرِ الْوَحْيَ مِنْ رُؤْيَاهُ إِنَّ لَهُ
bayts.e: قَلْبًا إِذَا نَامَتِ الْعَيْنَانِ لَمْ يَنَمِ
t: Do not deny revelation from his dreaming, because
His heart, though his eyes may shut, is open wide and does see.
And that was so at the very start of his prophethood:
So with that state of the dreaming no one can disagree.
How blest is God: revelation isn’t something attained;
Nor is a prophet suspected in what we do not see.
How many times has his palm by touch relieved the unwell,
And freed the helpless from in the noose of insanity.

bayts.e: حَتَّى حَكَتْ غُرَّةً فِي الْأَعْصُرِ الدُّهُمِ
t: His call gave life to a grey and barren year full of drought;
Till it became like a star in ages of ebony;

bayts.s: بِعَارِضٍ جَادَ أَوْ خِلْتَ الْبِطَاحَ بِهَا
bayts.e: سَيْبٌ مِنَ الْيَمِّ أَوْ سَيْلٌ مِنَ الْعَرِمِ
t: With teeming clouds — you’d have thought the valleys had rivers flow
In from the sea, or a flooded dam that gushed viciously.

bayts.e: ظُهُورَ نَارِ الْقِرَى لَيْلًا عَلَى عَلَمِ
t: Leave me alone to describe his miracles, which are plain
As nightly fire on mountains, lit as a courtesy.
For pearls increase in their beauty when arranged on a string,
But are not less precious kept alone and separately.

bayts.e: مَا فِيهِ مِنْ كَرَمِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
t: What eulogizing has any hope of stretching to reach
What he possesses in noble nature and quality?
True signs from the Merciful, originated in time,
Beginningless, trait of Him Who is beginninglessly.

bayts.e: عَنِ الْمَعَادِ وَعَنْ عَادٍ وَعَنْ إِرَمِ
t: They are not bound by constraints of time, as they tell us of
The day to come, also ʿĀd and Irum — past history.

bayts.e: مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ إِذْ جَاءَتْ وَلَمْ تَدُمِ
t: They stayed among us, and so transcended all miracles
From all the prophets, as they had come and then ceased to be.

bayts.e: لِذِي شِقَاقٍ وَمَا يَبْغِينَ مِنْ حَكَمِ
t: So wise and clear, that they leave no room for a single doubt
To an opponent and have no need for a referee.

bayts.s: مَا حُورِبَتْ قَطُّ إِلَّا عَادَ مِنْ حَرَبٍ
t: And never were they attacked except that from battle did
Return to them with surrendered arms the worst enemy.

bayts.e: رَدَّ الْغَيُورِ يَدَ الْجَانِي عَنِ الْحُرَمِ
t: Their eloquence fought off their dissenters’ claim, as a man
That is protective fights off attack from his family.

bayts.s: لَهَا مَعَانٍ كَمَوْجِ الْبَحْرِ فِي مَدَدٍ
t: Possessing meanings like waves upon the sea in support;
Surpassing its treasures in allure and sublimity.
Such that their wonders are countless and beyond any bound,
And never found to be tiresome in great quantity.

bayts.s: قَرَّتْ بِهَا عَيْنُ قَارِيهَا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ
t: By them is soothed their reciter’s eye, so I said to him,
“You have indeed found the rope of God, so hold steadily.”

bayts.s: إِنْ تَتْلُهَا خِيفَةً مِنْ حَرِّ نَارِ لَظَى
bayts.e: أَطْفَأْتَ حَرَّ لَظَى مِنْ وِرْدِهَا الشَّبِمِ
t: If you recite them in worry of the fire of Hell,
From their cool fountain you douse the burn of Hell utterly.
Just like the Basin, as it is whitening every face,
Of sinners coming to it like coals as black as can be.

bayts.e: فَالْقِسْطُ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا فِي النَّاسِ لَمْ يَقُمِ
t: And like the straight Bridge and like the Balance in equity:
Without them no justice is maintained in society.
Be not amazed by a hater in denial of them,
Who acts unknowing despite full knowledge and mastery.

bayts.s: قَدْ تُنْكِرُ الْعَيْنُ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ رَمَدٍ
bayts.e: وَيُنْكِرُ الْفَمُ طَعْمَ الْمَاءِ مِنْ سَقَمِ
t: An eye may even reject the light of sun when inflamed;
A mouth rejecting the taste of water from malady.

bayts.s: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ يَمَّمَ الْعَافُونَ سَاحَتَهُ
t: O best of those whose front yard is sought by those seeking good,
On foot and on backs of camels treading vigorously!
And you who are sign supreme for one who does seek to know!
And greatest blessing for one in search of prosperity!

bayts.s: سَرَيْتَ مِنْ حَرَمٍ لَيْلًا إِلَى حَرَمِ
bayts.e: كَمَا سَرَى الْبَدْرُ فِي دَاجٍ مِنَ الظُّلَمِ
t: From sanctum to sanctum you had made the trip overnight;
Just as the moon makes the trip through darkness nocturnally.

bayts.s: وَبِتَّ تَرْقَى إِلَى أَنْ نِلْتَ مَنْزِلَةً
bayts.e: مِنْ قَابِ قَوْسَيْنِ لَمْ تُدْرَكْ وَلَمْ تُرَمِ
t: You spent the night rising up until you had reached a place
A length of two bows, not gained or sought in all history.
And all the prophets and messengers had put you ahead,
Just as the served over servants has the priority.

bayts.e: فِي مَوْكِبٍ كُنْتَ فِيهِ صَاحِبَ الْعَلَمِ
t: As you proceeded through all the seven levels with them,
In a procession, you were the banner bearer to see.

bayts.s: حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ تَدَعْ شَأْوًا لِمُسْتَبِقٍ
t: Until you had left no goal for the ambitious in hope
Of closeness, nor height for someone seeking ascendency.
You humbled all ranks by annexation: you were addressed,
Like unannexed proper noun, with singular dignity.
So that you triumph with a connection oh so concealed
From eyes, and a secret oh so shrouded in mystery!
So you obtained every glory, no one else joining you;
And you surpassed all alone, unchallenged, every degree.

bayts.s: وَجَلَّ مِقْدَارُ مَا وُلِّيتَ مِنْ رُتَبٍ
bayts.e: وَعَزَّ إِدْرَاكُ مَا أُولِيتَ مِنْ نِعَمِ
t: The measure of stations you were granted, what majesty!
Attaining the blessings you were given, what rarity!

bayts.s: بُشْرَى لَنَا مَعْشَرَ الْإِسْلَامِ إِنَّ لَنَا
t: Great news for us, people of Islam! Indeed, we possess
A pillar of special care erected unbreakably.
And since Allah called the one who called us to serving Him
The Greatest Prophet, we are the greatest community.
The news of his being sent alarmed the hearts of the foes,
Just like a roar causing heedless sheep to startle and flee.

bayts.s: مَا زَالَ يَلْقَاهُمْ فِي كُلِّ مُعْتَرَكٍ
bayts.e: حَتَّى حَكَوْا بِالْقَنَا لَحْمًا عَلَى وَضَمِ
t: He kept courageously facing them at each battlefield,
Till they were butchered by spears like meat in a butchery.
They longed to flee so much that they watched the parts carried off
By buzzards and vultures in a state of near jealousy.

bayts.e: مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنْ لَيَالِي الْأَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ
t: The nights would pass with them unaware the number of them,
Except the nights of the Sacred Months of tranquillity.

bayts.e: بِكُلِّ قَرْمٍ إِلَى لَحْمِ الْعِدَى قَرِمِ
t: As if religion had been a guest arrived at their yard,
With every nobleman craving meat of the enemy.
It brought an ocean of troops on gracefully-floating steeds,
Advancing waves made of heroes, surging successively.
Each in response to the call of God, in hope of reward,
Attacking armed to uproot and shatter idolatry.

bayts.s: حَتَّى غَدَتْ مِلَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ وَهْيَ بِهِمْ
t: Until the Faith of Islam, with them among it, became —
Once having been foreign — now a unified family.

bayts.e: وَخَيْرِ بَعْلٍ فَلَمْ تَيْتَمْ وَلَمْ تَئِمِ
t: Protected forever from them by the best father and
Best husband, so not an orphan or a widow is she.

bayts.e: مَاذَا رَأَى مِنْهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُصْطَدَمِ
t: They are the mountains, so ask about them their battle-foe,
At every battle, the things from them that he used to see.

bayts.s: وَسَلْ حُنَيْنًا وَسَلْ بَدْرًا وَسَلْ أُحُدًا
bayts.e: فُصُولَ حَتْفٍ لَهُمْ أَدْهَى مِنَ الْوَخَمِ
t: And ask Ḥunayn, question Badr, and even ask Uḥud, too —
Events of death for them, worse than plague in catastrophe.

bayts.s: الْمُصْدِرِي الْبِيضِ حُمْرًا بَعْدَ مَا وَرَدَتْ
bayts.e: مِنَ الْعِدَا كُلَّ مُسْوَدٍّ مِنَ اللِّمَمِ
t: Returning white blades now turned to crimson after they reached
The fighters with flowing hair of black from the enemy.
Inscribing with spears of Lettering, their pens didn’t leave
A body line with undotted i, and crossed every t.
With sharpened weapons they had a mark to set them apart;
A rose is set by its mark apart from a thorny tree.

bayts.e: فَتَحْسَبُ الزَّهْرَ فِي الْأَكْمَامِ كُلَّ كَمِي
t: The victory winds convey to you the sweet news of them;
So flowers in bloom you’d reckon every soldier to be.

bayts.s: كَأَنَّهُمْ فِي ظُهُورِ الْخَيْلِ نَبْتُ رُبًى
bayts.e: مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحَزْمِ لَا مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحُزُمِ
t: They were in horseback like firmly-rooted plants up on hills —
From grit so solid, not girth of saddle held solidly.

bayts.s: طَارَتْ قُلُوبُ الْعِدَا مِنْ بَأْسِهِمْ فَرَقًا
t: The enemies’ hearts were fluttering in fear of their force,
Unable to tell a lamb apart from brave cavalry.

bayts.e: إِنْ تَلْقَهُ الْأُسْدُ فِي أَجَامِهَا تَجِمِ
t: Whoever is aided by the Messenger of Allāh,
If lions meet him inside their woods, they bow silently.

bayts.s: وَلَنْ تَرَى مِنْ وَلِيٍّ غَيْرِ مُنْتَصِرٍ
bayts.e: بِهِ وَلَا مِنْ عَدُوٍّ غَيْرِ مُنْقَصِمِ
t: You will not see any saint that isn’t victorious
Through him, nor any opponent not destroyed utterly.

bayts.e: كَاللَّيْثِ حَلَّ مَعَ الْأَشْبَالِ فِي أَجَمِ
t: He put his nation to dwell inside the fort of his faith;
Like lion dwelling inside the forest with progeny.

bayts.s: كَمْ جَدَّلَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ مِنْ جَدِلٍ
bayts.e: فِيهِ وَكَمْ خَصَمَ الْبُرْهَانُ مِنْ خَصِمِ
t: How often the words of God refuted the quarrelsome
About him! How often proof defeated the enemy!
Enlightenment in the one unread is wonder enough,
In Age of Darkness; and good upbringing in orphancy.

bayts.e: ذُنُوبَ عُمْرٍ مَضَى فِي الشِّعْرِ وَالْخِدَمِ
t: I’ve served him with eulogy by which I seek to erase
The sins of life spent in poem and in servility.
For they have led me to things of horrible aftermath;
Akin to livestock decreed by them for the butchery.

bayts.s: أَطَعْتُ غَيَّ الصِّبَا فِي الْحَالَتَيْنِ وَمَا
t: I have obeyed the deceit of youth in both cases and
Got nothing but sins and then regret, oh, what misery!

bayts.e: لَمْ تَشْتَرِ الدِّينَ بِالدُّنْيَا وَلَمْ تَسُمِ
t: Oh, what a loss for my soul, the awful deal that it made!
Not buying faith with this world, not even browsing to see.

bayts.e: يَبِنْ لَهُ الْغَبْنُ فِي بَيْعٍ وَفِي سَلَمِ
t: Whoever sells off his future for his present will come
To see the loss in his sale and future delivery.

bayts.s: إِنْ آتِ ذَنْبًا فَمَا عَهْدِي بِمُنْتَقِضٍ
t: If I engage in a sin, my covenant isn’t void
With him, the Prophet; nor is the rope dissevered from me.
By naming my son Muḥammad I am in pledge to him;
And none is more faithful in fulfilling pledges than he.

bayts.s: إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي مَعَادِي آخِذًا بِيَدِي
bayts.e: فَضْلًا وَإِلَّا فَقُلْ يَا زَلَّةَ الْقَدَمِ
t: At my appointment, if he’s not holding onto my hand —
In graciousness — say, “Oh, what a fall into tragedy!”

bayts.e: أَوْ يَرْجِعَ الْجَارُ مِنْهُ غَيْرَ مُحْتَرَمِ
t: Far be it from him to bar the aspirant of his gifts,
Or send away in dishonor from him a refugee.
And since committing my thoughts to singing praises of him,
I’ve found him to be the most committed to saving me.

bayts.s: وَلَنْ يَفُوتَ الْغِنَى مِنْهُ يَدًا تَرِبَتْ
bayts.e: إِنَّ الْحَيَا يُنْبِتُ الْأَزْهَارَ فِي الْأَكَمِ
t: The riches from him will not neglect a poor, dusty hand;
Indeed, the rain causes even hills to be flowery.

bayts.s: وَلَمْ أُرِدْ زَهْرَةَ الدُّنْيَا الَّتِي اقْتَطَفَتْ
bayts.e: يَدَا زُهَيْرٍ بِمَا أَثْنَى عَلَى هَرِمِ
t: I sought no bloom of the lower world the hands of Zuhayr
Had picked for having presented Herim with flattery.

bayts.s: يَا أَكْرَمَ الْخَلْقِ مَا لِي مَنْ أَلُوذُ بِهِ
t: Most Noble of All Creation, what refuge do I have
But you at the coming of the global emergency?

bayts.s: وَلَنْ يَضِيقَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جَاهُكَ بِي
t: O Messenger of Allāh, your rank won’t shrink from me when
The Generous manifests His punishing quality.
Yes, from your grace is indeed the world as well as its mate;
And of your knowledge the Tablet and the Pen of decree.

bayts.s: يَا نَفْسُ لَا تَقْنَطِي مِنْ زَلَّةٍ عَظُمَتْ
t: O soul, despair not because of a mistake that is grave;
Enormities are like slips compared to His Clemency.

bayts.e: تَأْتِي عَلَى حَسَبِ الْعِصْيَانِ فِي الْقِسَمِ
t: And hopefully, mercy from my Lord when He gives it out
Will come according to sinfulness in its quantity.

bayts.s: يَا رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ رَجَائِي غَيْرَ مُنْعَكِسٍ
t: My Lord, and make not my hope a hope that is overturned
With you; and make my expectance with no deficiency.

bayts.s: وَالْطُفْ بِعَبْدِكَ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ إِنَّ لَهُ
t: Be kind to Your slave in both abodes; for his fortitude
Whenever terrors call out to it will turn tail and flee.
Let clouds of blessing from You, unending, rain down upon
The Prophet, with pouring rain so heavily, steadily.

bayts.s: مَا رَنَّحَتْ عَذَبَاتِ الْبَانِ رِيحُ صَبًا
t: For longer than willow branches by the east wind are swayed;
And camel drivers excite the camels with melody.

bayts.s: ثُمَّ الرِّضَا عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعَنْ عُمَرٍ
bayts.e: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَعَنْ عُثْمَانَ ذِي الْكَرَمِ
t: Then pleasure with Abū Bakr, the greatest of company,
And ʿUmar, bearer of Truth, and then ʿUthmān, and ʿAlī,
The Family and Companions and all the Followers,
The people of purity and patience and piety.

bayts.e: وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا مَضَى يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ
t: My Lord, by the Chosen One, make our hopes come to be,
And pardon us what has gone, O Vast in Gen’rosity.

bayts.e: يَتْلُونَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى وَفِي الْحَرَمِ
t: And please, my God, do forgive all of the Muslims by what
They all recite at the Holy Mosque and the Sanctity.

bayts.s: بِجَاهِ مَنْ بَيْتُهُ فِي طَيْبَةٍ حَرَمٌ
t: By the prestige of him who the Goodly Land is his home;
Whose very name is an oath of greatest immensity.

bayts.e: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فِي بَدْءٍ وَفِي خَتَمِ
t: This is the Burdah of the Selected One, now complete;
And praise Allāh at the start and finish, eternally!

bayts.s: أَبْيَاتُهَا قَدْ أَتَتْ سِتِّينَ مَعْ مِائَةٍ
bayts.e: فَرِّجْ بِهَا كَرْبَنَا يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ
t: The number of verses in it is one sixty or more;
Relieve by them our woes, O Vast in Gen’rosity!

bayts.e: سَأَلْتُكَ الْخَيْرَ يَا ذَا الْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ
t: Especially the composer and the translator and
All the reciters with passion and in sincerity.
